scope: Complete per-dataset scientific products. These are mathematical definitions, not numerical execution.

per_case.balanced_accuracy: For fixed K semantic classes, BAC=(1/K)Σ_c TP_c/N_c. Every declared class requires N_c>0; otherwise null with class/support reason, without silently reducing K.
per_case.cohen_kappa: p_o=Σ_c C_cc/N; p_e=Σ_c(row_c/N)(col_c/N); κ=(p_o−p_e)/(1−p_e), null when N=0 or p_e=1. Confusion axis truth×prediction fixed. H native fallback can be separately recorded, never used to hide undefinedness.
per_case.weighted_f1: For every declared class, F1_c=2TP_c/(2TP_c+FP_c+FN_c); zero-denominator convention0 recorded; weighted F1=Σ_c(N_c/N)F1_c. Whole-support N>0 required; absent classes flagged separately.
per_case.auroc: Binary only; pairwise ranking probability P(s_positive>s_negative)+0.5P(tie). Both classes required. Use declared positive-class probability; a source logit-specific scoring convention is a distinct H policy. Do not average batch AUC as full-case AUC.
per_case.hard_prediction: Argmax ordered K probabilities; deterministic first class in fixed semantic order for ties. Binary one-logit output uses explicit sigmoid and threshold0.5, common across candidate/references; threshold tuning allowed only if preregistered development-only method and reported separately.
per_case.log_loss: −N^−1Σ_i log(max(p_i,y_i,1e−15)); probability validation precedes clipping and correction is recorded. Prospective secondary endpoint, not an original-paper metric.
per_case.brier: N^−1Σ_iΣ_c(p_ic−1[y_i=c])²; multiclass unscaled sum, binary still uses both columns. Prospective secondary endpoint.
per_case.abstention: No invented prediction. Report all expected rows/cases, abstention and failure counts; per-protocol metric only on a completely valid case, coverage alongside it. Whole-task qualification requires full collection; selective completed-only score cannot replace it.

reductions.primary_reproduction: Each of three runs: compute each required fold metric on its full assessment support, then arithmetic mean over all required folds for that dataset/method. Report mean of three run means and sample SD with denominator2. This independent convention preserves predecessor; original native fold/epoch aggregation is separately unqualified and must be bound before H historical parity.
reductions.kaggle: Four per-fold metrics average within each run, with same ten assessment people in all folds. Do not concatenate repeated predictions and claim40 people. An ensemble mean-probability metric is optional separately named, not the paper average.
reductions.sleep: Ten fold metrics averaged per run with intended60/20/20 person support and all nights grouped. Prospective cyclic partitions cause repeat assessment of a person; shared person cluster across folds. Report both full support and effective unique biological count.
reductions.source_comparisons: Original method rows copied from other papers require their actual cohort/run provenance. Shared-support regenerated references and documentary copied historical results are separate reports.
reductions.inference: Paired cluster bootstrap over biological people within dataset, all of a person's events/recordings and all paired method/access/fold outputs together; 2000 preregistered draws and frozen RNG for prospective intervals. Recompute metrics/reductions inside each draw; invalid class-support draws counted and reported; if valid-draw fraction<0.95, return interval unavailable and a support warning, not resample until significant. Monte Carlo draw count is a declared analysis choice, not an original-paper claim. Keep source-generation outputs, fitted states and c*(d,f) fixed. This conditions on the completed adaptive procedure and its realized runs, not a bootstrap of retraining or a population claim. Repeated/overlapping training creates dependence; all exchangeability assumptions remain qualification gates.
reductions.seed_uncertainty: Report all three run means and SD separately. Person-cluster interval conditions on these runs/checkpoint identities. No claim to estimate a pretraining-run population from one checkpoint. If original/new pretraining repetitions exist, group nested downstream runs by parent state and report that hierarchy. If M_a shares development across its three local runs, label their dependence; stochastic fit streams remain separate. SD is descriptive, not a claim of independent adaptive searches.
reductions.arms: Use matched case/seed/support and cluster draws to compute B−A access effect. Candidate source generation and learning may differ between arms; references may be shared only under exact policy identity. Independence of A/B contexts is a gate. Both M_A/M_B are pre-exposure frozen; per-fold contexts and all ancestry isolated, common scientific requirements complete. Reference selection S_df is identical and candidate-independent under any A/B bank alias.
reductions.multiple_endpoints: All seven primary dataset monitors and original metrics always reported. H01: seven selected-rule descriptive deltas and support/intervals; H02: conditional Holm7 comparison to S_df only if assumptions qualified; H03: mandatory all28 fixed-control deltas; H04: separate Holm28 all-four claim; H05: full scientific/access/exposure/resources. No post-hoc choice between the two families, no best metric or weighted cross-dataset headline. Other endpoints/access effects are descriptive unless separately preregistered at G0.
reductions.significance: For a preregistered paired predictive comparison, use a person-cluster method-label swap randomization test: swap candidate/reference full prediction blocks together for each biological person, preserving all their folds, events and runs, then recompute the frozen dataset statistic. Enumerate all2^n assignments for n<=16 anduseexactp=(#assignmentswithdelta>=observeddelta)/2^n,includingtheobservedassignment. Otherwise use9999 frozen independent assignments plus the observed configuration with p=(1+#null_delta>=observed_delta)/(1+B). Ties counted conservatively. The method-exchangeability null/conditioning assumption must be stated; this is not causal inference. If that assumption or support is untenable, report effect/interval without confirmatoryp orsuperiority claim.
reductions.comparison_family: Select c*(d,f) independently within each outer fold using all four controls and all three valid development monitor summaries for that fold only, fixed order EEGPT_linear_probe, EEGPT_full_finetune, EEGNet, fixed_spectral_ridge. Freeze before query. The primary reference is S_df, a composite fold-local selection procedure, not one globally selected named control. Seven selected-policy deltas and all28 fixed-control effects are mandatory. Conditional p-values use Holm across7 for S_df and a separately reported Holm28 family for any all-four claim; unavailable tests retain planned place with explicit non-rejection bookkeeping, not invented p measurements. Complete REFERENCE_SELECTION_CONTRACT governs.

comparison_definitions.reproduction: Compare each candidate numerical product to independently generated qualified reference product under identical recipe/support. Report absolute/signed errors, method identity and availability. Thresholds are product-specific and frozen by independent native/numerical qualification, not candidate outcomes. Original printed decimals only supply rounding intervals for documentary aggregate comparisons.
comparison_definitions.improvement: For every dataset report the candidate against each of EEGPT LP, EEGPT FT, EEGNet and spectral ridge and the prespecified fold-local selected-reference policy S_df. Signed monitor delta=candidate-reference; logloss improvement=reference-candidate. H01–H05 and REFERENCE_SELECTION_CONTRACT define exact equal-fold/run aggregation and conditional claims; no globally pooled development selection.
comparison_definitions.resource_efficiency: Report runtime, total/peak resource observations and inherited model/pretrain costs separately from predictive quality. A lower-cost method is not automatically statistically superior; matched caps and cost/performance frontier are explicit.
comparison_definitions.training_curves: LA/LR numerators and denominators tied to exact normalized targets/mask axes; compare complete scheduled validation curves and final declared checkpoint without picking the best assessment step.
comparison_definitions.scaling: Use all8 model points and4 fraction points in their source-selected studies. Positive outcomes fit log(y)=α+βlog(x) with declared units; publish raw values, residuals and fit sensitivity. Original printed exponent/scale and inverted-looking plot axes remain documentary identity issues. No forced power law or extrapolation outside observed range.
comparison_definitions.diagnostics: Cosine matrices and edge sets use exact channel order; perturbation Pearson denominator uses all planned draws; confusion is independently reconstructed; attention sums/axes checked; t-SNE image orientation not compared as an invariant scientific endpoint. Diagnostic reproducibility remains separate from proof of neural mechanism.

reporting: Always expected/observed/valid/abstained/failed/undefined denominators by dataset, fold, run, method, family and arm; original and new source gaps; no scalar global pass for a partial family.
reference_selection: REFERENCE_SELECTION_CONTRACT.json is the exact prospective strongest-development-control procedure S_df, statistic, failure policy and H01–H05 reporting hierarchy.
